set.v: $250 in gold (12 x $20 + 1 x $10) in a copper box
set.tovw: Lead grade F (treasure thread): found 1930, $250, nothing further reported
set.t: The whole find was one small box. No paper reports a second box or a claimant, so there is no open lead, only the question of who buried it. The 1930 reprint says 3 mi SW of town while the plat puts the farm NW; see the pin note. Access: Private farmland: ask permission.

tw-mn-walnut-grove-bergblom-copper-box-1.st: The Tracy paper adds that the tree and its stump were long gone by 1930 and that the spot was about 40 rods from the highway.
src: Redwood Gazette, 14 Jan 1932, p. 12, tax list: Bergblom family, Town of Springdale, School Dist. 22 (Newspapers.com 849986344)
